description: This file defines the Config class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing application configuration parameters, constants, and loading configuration files. It provides methods to retrieve, set, add, and clear configuration data, as well as to handle the instantiation of configuration objects.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A class that manages application-wide configuration constants and parameters, loading configuration files, and providing access methods.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given configuration name, with an optional default.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a configuration with the specified name exists.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets or updates the value for a given configuration name.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Merges new configuration parameters into existing ones.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all configuration parameters as an array.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks whether the configuration system is properly installed by attempting to load the configuration file.

methods.name: getConf
methods.description: Returns the configuration object, optionally forcing a reload.
